subject: AWS Channel Private Offer: reseller entitlement mapping & escalation path
messages:
From: Nina Park <nina.park@cloudresell.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@cloudresell.com, psp@amazon.com
Date: 2027-06-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Mapping entitlements for AWS Channel Private Offer

Hi Irene,

Thanks for taking this — excuse the long email but I want to make sure we capture the constraints up front so the CPPO setup doesn't stall on the entitlement side. We have a trial customer (Acme Corp) that will buy through CloudResell and needs: 

- Per-seat entitlements (10 seats initially) tied to a single marketplace subscription
- SKU-level metering mapped to the vendor SKU in AWS Marketplace
- An escalation contact at Redwood for any SKU/synchronization mismatches during provisioning

Can you confirm whether Redwood can:
1) Provide a single PPP (private pricing) entity that maps multiple product SKUs into one entitlement?
2) Support a delegated provisioner flow where CloudResell creates the subscription and Redwood validates entitlements via API?

I've attached a short PDF listing the expected SKUs and some edge cases (usage patterns where customers prepay vs monthly billing). We need to lock mapping by next Thursday to hit Acme's procurement window.

Also cc'ing AWS Partner Success to keep them in the loop for the marketplace/onboarding ticket.

Thanks,
Nina Park
Head of Solutions, CloudResell Solutions
attachments: initial_requirements.pdf
From: irene.choi@redwood.ai
To: Nina Park <nina.park@cloudresell.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, psp@amazon.com
Date: 2027-06-15T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mapping entitlements for AWS Channel Private Offer

Hi Nina — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Ben (sales engineering) and Marissa (channel lead) to scope the mapping and escalation path. Quick answers inline: 

- Single PPP entity mapping multiple SKUs: Yes — we can create a composite entitlement tier for the marketplace private offer, but we need a canonical SKU mapping table.
- Delegated provisioner flow: We support API-based validation; implementation detail depends on how CloudResell plans to create subscriptions (CloudResell-managed vs customer-managed).

Action items I propose so we can lock by Thursday: 
1) Ben to confirm SKU <-> Redwood product-id mapping and surface any incompatible flags.
2) CloudResell to confirm whether subscriptions will be created under CloudResell's AWS account or customer accounts.
3) Marissa to own escalation contact and SLA for entitlement mismatches (first response 4 business hours).

Ben/Marissa — can you confirm your availability for a 30-min call tomorrow 10–10:30am PT? If not, propose alternatives in this thread.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Partner Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Irene / Nina —

Quick heads-up on SKU mapping after a 30-min review with product infra: attached is a CSV with the initial mapping and a column called "edge_flag" where I've marked items that need manual reconciliation during provisioning. Summary: 

- We can map multiple vendor SKUs to a single entitlement tier (we create an entitlement alias).
- SKU metering is supported but items with usage-based metering require an extra reconciliation step (we can surface mismatches via a webhook).
- Pricing delta: for the composite entitlement Redwood needs a 3% adjustment to the listed per-token price to cover aggregation overhead (this is configurable).

DocuSign link for the reseller addendum (contains the delegated provisioner language): https://docuSign.example/rdw-ppo-4881

I'm available for the 10am PT call tomorrow and will bring the SKU mapping file.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
attachments: sku-mapping.csv

Cc: psp@amazon.com, procurement@acme.com
Date: 2027-06-18T14:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mapping entitlements for AWS Channel Private Offer

Thanks everyone — good sync earlier today. Recap & escalation playbook attached so CloudResell and Acme procurement have a single reference: 

1) Entitlement matrix: see entitlement_matrix.xlsx (contains Redwood product-id, CloudResell SKU, metering type, and reconciliation owner).
2) Provisioning flow: CloudResell creates subscription under CloudResell-managed account -> Redwood webhook validates entitlements -> on mismatch Redwood opens a ticket and notifies CloudResell ops.
3) SLA & escalation:
   - P1 (subscription prevent provisioning): Redwood response within 4 business hours; AWS Partner Success looped after 8 business hours.
   - P2 (metering mismatch): Redwood response within 1 business day.
4) DocuSign: Ben shared the reseller addendum link; procurement at Acme should sign the addendum prior to PO.

Next steps for CloudResell/Acme: confirm account ownership for subscription creation and approve the entitlement_matrix.xlsx by COB Friday. If you prefer, we can attach the AWS case and run a joint triage session with Partner Success.

Marissa Cole
Channel Partnerships, Redwood Inference
attachments: entitlement_matrix.xlsx
